text.tspan: Writing normally takes one pass of the whole model per word. In
small extra head guesses the word after the next; the next pass checks
that guess at the same time as it computes its own word. A right guess
means two words for one pass. The answer is identical — the real

text.tspan: Training moves each weight matrix along a few strong directions while the
rest barely move. Muon reshapes every update so that all its directions
move by about the same amount, with five cheap matrix multiplications
uses it for the weight matrices inside the layers.
